description: This source file implements functions for translating OpenGL ES shader texture functions into HLSL code, including handling of texture coordinate wrapping, size queries, and sampling functions. It defines a class for managing these texture functions and their code generation.

classes.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::TextureFunction
classes.description: Represents a specific texture function with parameters such as sampler type, coordinates, method, projection, and offset. Provides methods to generate unique function names and determine return types based on parameters.

methods.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::useTextureFunction
methods.description: Determines the appropriate texture function implementation based on the function name, sampler type, argument count, and shader type. Sets up the TextureFunction parameters accordingly.

methods.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::textureFunctionHeader
methods.description: Generates the shader code for all used texture functions, including their headers and bodies, based on the specified output type and whether size queries ignore base level.
